currentSource: uncommitted worktree after API review fixes
limitations: Background desktop/browser processes were active; forward/reverse medians are ranges, not confidence intervals.
Empty executors: no server, network, nonempty-row decoding, sustained heap or tail latency measurements.
New expression benchmark uses PostgreSQL only. Equivalent native math/LEFT use hand-written native SQL templates.
fragments-prebuilt measures synchronous native PreVisitor/FragmentGen; fetchList cases also include SQL stringification/binding and empty execution.

forward.methodology: 7 samples, median microseconds per operation; >=40 ms per sample; warmup; GC outside timing; independent processes; native PostgreSQL renderer + empty mock executor; identical SQL and bindings checked
